en.title: Rayman Legends Retold Adds Exclusive Rabbids Costume for Switch 2 Players
en.summary: Rayman's latest adventure, Rayman Legends Retold, is bringing a fun new exclusive costume to the Nintendo Switch 2. Players can unlock a special Rabbids outfit for free, adding a touch of familiar chaos to the platforming fun.
en.body:
Get ready to jump back into the vibrant world of **Rayman** with **Rayman Legends Retold**, a reimagining of the beloved platformer that's set to launch this December. While the game promises a wealth of new content and features across multiple platforms, Ubisoft has revealed a special treat exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2 owners: a **Rayman Rabbids costume**.

This unique outfit lets players dress Rayman in the iconic, chaotic style of the mischievous Rabbids, a fan-favorite element that has spun off into its own successful series. The good news for Switch 2 players is that this crossover costume won't cost a thing. Upon your first visit to Victor Velour's costume shop within the game, the Rayman Rabbids outfit will be unlocked and available for free, offering an immediate dose of playful nostalgia.

## A Familiar Face in a New Dimension

**Rayman Legends Retold** is poised to bring its signature blend of fluid platforming and stunning art direction to a new generation. The game is slated for release on October 1, 2026, and will be available on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, in addition to the Nintendo Switch 2. For those opting for physical copies, both the PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2 versions will receive a retail release, with the latter featuring a Game Key Card. The addition of the Rabbids costume is a clever way to acknowledge the series' broader universe and reward players for choosing the Nintendo platform, tapping into the established popularity of these bumbling creatures.

## What This Means for Fans

For the passionate **Rayman** community, this exclusive costume is more than just a cosmetic item; it's a celebration of the franchise's legacy. The **Rabbids** have become synonymous with Ubisoft's playful spirit, and seeing them integrated into Rayman's world, even as an outfit, is a delightful callback. It adds an extra layer of charm and replayability, encouraging players to explore the game's fashion options. While many games offer pre-order bonuses or paid DLC, this free, in-game unlock for a specific platform is a welcome gesture that fosters goodwill and excitement among players eagerly anticipating the game's launch.

## What's Next

With **Rayman Legends Retold** set to release in December, players can look forward to diving into its colorful world. Keep an eye out for further details on additional costumes and gameplay features as the launch date approaches. The exclusive Rabbids costume for the Nintendo Switch 2 is just the first of many exciting reveals we can expect.
